Plan_of_Care.content: Prescribe stronger topical corticosteroid from clinic to start for current flare

Plan_of_Care.content: Prescribe emollients and bath/shower emollient to be used regularly for 7–10 days

Plan_of_Care.content: Offer prescription for oral antihistamine such as fexofenadine to try

Plan_of_Care.content: Advise patient to keep a diary of potential triggers such as soaps, shower gels, and clothing and to avoid irritants
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Advise keeping diary of potential triggers (soaps, shower gels, clothing) and avoid irritants

Follow_up_Information.content: Advised to return or be reviewed in 1 week if no improvement or sooner if worsening including infection, bleeding, or systemic symptoms
